lines.t: Yeah, talk to me, no defense, just truth to me
I've been swinging scripture like a hammer, I know
Turning every argument into I told you so
I've been wearing husband like a shirt I never earned
Blaming all your fire for the way my pride burns
I lose patience, raise my voice then I quote grace
Say I'm fighting for your soul, but it's my case
I see the hurt in your eyes when I try to be king
When I should just be a servant and let my actions sink
Girl, I'm not here to win this fight
I'm trying to learn how to love you right
So if I ever make you feel less than free
Call me, I don't let it sit inside and bleed
I've been using silence like a weapon, I know
Storming around the house, making sure that you know
I throw a history like stones at your name
Then cry in the mirror saying you're the one to blame
I run to my family when I feel their heat
Paint you as a villain playing on repeat
I see the way it hits you when I twist you in ten
When you're trying to give me love and I cash it as rent
Boy, I'm not here to keep these walls
I'm trying to learn how to heal your heart
So if I ever make you feel you're alone
Say my name, don't let me stay cold as stone
I'm scared you'll never trust the man I can be
I'm scared you'll never really feel safe with me
I'm scared my past mistakes will ruin our day
I'm scared my triggers will chase you away
But if we put our fears down on the floor
Maybe that's the start of something more
What if we could build a home out of truth and grace
Turn our weakness into light in this broken place
What if we could hold our kids with steady hands
Show them how to flood our circumstance
We're not there yet, but I wanna believe
If we both change, we could be a family
I see a little girl with your eyes, my patience growing
Bible on the table and the TV barely going
I'm home on time, put my phone face down
Praying over dinner while you laugh at the sound
No more secret anger in the room where we sleep
I be quick to say, I'm slow to speak
I be leading by the way that I carry the weight
Not by talking like I'm perfect or a step too great
I see a little boy with your smile, my voice softer
Hands on your shoulders saying you're a good father
No more group chats turning you into a joke
I'll cover you in prayer every word I spoke
I learned how to breathe when my feelings ignite
Come to you first when my chest gets tight
I'll be building you up when the days get rough
Let forgiveness be the language when it's not enough
I put my ego in the ground
I lay my defenses down
I let my hands reach louder than my mouth
I'll let my love speak when my fears get loud
If it keeps us in the same story
We'll turn every scar into glory
What if we could build a home out of truth and grace
Turn our weakness into light in this broken place
What if we could hold our kids with steady hands
Show them how to flood our silken stand
We're not there yet, but I'm ready to see
If we both change, we could be a family
What if one day there's a ring and a vow that stays
And our daughters, our sons learn to walk his ways
If he writes our names together, then let it be
Cause I'm down to grow if you'll grow with me
No more you versus me
Just us on our knees
We learn to love like that
Maybe that's what we are like then
Maybe that's what we could be
